cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)

# Measurement unit conversion: the compiled unit table (vscphelper) and the
# expression based alternative (vscpunitexpr).
project(test_vscpunits LANGUAGES CXX C)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED True)

find_package(GTest REQUIRED)

add_executable(unittest_vscpunits unittest.cpp)

# The unit expressions generated by vscp-classes (script/make_vscphelper_units.py json)
target_compile_definitions(unittest_vscpunits PRIVATE
    VSCP_UNITS_JSON="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../src/vscp/common/vscp-units.json"
    _USE_MATH_DEFINES
)

target_link_libraries(unittest_vscpunits PRIVATE
    vscp_common
    GTest::GTest
    GTest::Main
)
